subject: Mosaic Health — split billing structure and collections cadence
messages:
From: Anna Kessler <anna.kessler@mosaichealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mosaic Health Billing <billing@mosaichealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing structure for Redwood pilot (SOW signed)

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the SOW. Before we go live, our finance team needs a confirmed invoicing approach. Mosaic has two legal entities that need to be billed separately for regulatory and cost-center reasons: Mosaic Health Services (MHS) and Mosaic Tech Solutions (MTS). We would prefer split invoices so each entity receives a document with only their line items and tax breakdown.

Questions from our side:
- Can Redwood emit two separate invoices from the same contract period (one per entity) while preserving one overall PO we provided?
- How will VAT/tax be applied if one entity is VAT-registered and the other is not?
- Can you provide a mapping template (line item -> entity) so our AP team can reconcile program spend to cost centers?

I attached a quick CSV with the cost center mapping we expect to use (mosaic-entity-mapping.csv). Please confirm the constraints and any routing requirements for payment collection.

Best,
Anna
Anna Kessler
Director, Finance Operations
Mosaic Health

[Attachment: mosaic-entity-mapping.csv (csv)]

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Kessler <anna.kessler@mosaichealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing structure for Redwood pilot (SOW signed)

Anna —

Appreciate the clear ask and the mapping file. Short answer: yes, we can produce split invoices per legal entity and route them to different AP contacts; there are a few details to align on VAT handling and the PO number usage. Looping in Ben (account exec) and Laura/Marcus from finance to flesh out the mechanics.

Immediate next steps we propose:
1) Finance mapping review — Laura/Marcus will confirm whether the current itemization in our invoice template supports per-line entity tagging.
2) VAT treatment decision — If one entity is VAT-registered, we need their VAT ID on the invoice line for correct tax calculation; if not registered we'll zero-rate accordingly.
3) Collections cadence — Decide whether Redwood should send separate invoice PDFs on the same date (preferred) or aggregate a single cover invoice plus entity-specific attachments.

I attached our invoice template and a draft mapping CSV that we can use to produce invoices programmatically. We'll aim to have a concrete proposal by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-invoice-template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Kessler <anna.kessler@mosaichealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing structure for Redwood pilot (SOW signed)

Team —

Reviewed Anna's CSV and Kim's template. Notes from finance:
- Our billing engine supports per-line entity assignment (we tag each invoice line with an entity_id). We can issue separate PDF invoices per entity with unique invoice numbers while linking them to one umbrella contract and PO.
- VAT: For the VAT-registered entity (please confirm the exact VAT ID), we will calculate tax at the line level. For the non-registered entity, we'll omit VAT and include a note: "No VAT registered — no tax charged."
- Payment instructions: We can route remittance emails to different addresses per entity; however, all payments will initially be collected into the same commercial bank account unless Mosaic requests separate beneficiary accounts (this adds reconciliation overhead).

Questions for Mosaic (cc'd):
- Please confirm the legal names and exact VAT IDs for MHS and MTS.
- Do you require separate remittance bank details? If yes, provide beneficiary wiring instructions.

Proposed deliverable: a three-file set delivered on invoice date —
A) invoice_MHS_<date>.pdf
B) invoice_MTS_<date>.pdf
C) summary_cover_<date>.pdf linking both with a single PO reference for AP reconciliation.

I'll produce a sample on Monday using the attached template.

Laura Bennett
Senior Billing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Anna Kessler <anna.kessler@mosaichealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mosaic Health Billing <billing@mosaichealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing structure for Redwood pilot (SOW signed)

Laura —

Thanks, that approach sounds workable. Confirming details below:
- Legal names and VAT IDs:
  * Mosaic Health Services, Inc. (MHS) — VAT/Tax ID: US-TIN-45-7890123
  * Mosaic Tech Solutions LLC (MTS) — VAT/Tax ID: not VAT-registered (US entity)
- Remittance: both entities want separate remittance contacts but we will pay to a single treasury account. Please use billing@mosaichealth.com for remittance notifications and cc finance-leads@ mosaichealth.com on the cover summary.

Two small asks before you produce the sample invoice: 
1) Can the per-line allocation be exported as a machine-readable CSV in addition to the PDFs for our internal ledger ingestion?
2) For credit-note workflows: if a line needs to be credited later, can Redwood issue entity-specific credit memos that reference the original invoice number?

Attached the signed SOW for completeness.

Appreciate it,
Anna

[Attachment: signed-sow-mosaic-v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Kessler <anna.kessler@mosaichealth.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing structure for Redwood pilot (SOW signed)

Hi Anna —

All good on our end. Final confirmations:
- We will produce two separate invoices with unique invoice numbers but link them to the single PO DL-2027-119 in the cover summary.
- Per-line machine-readable CSV export: yes — we'll deliver invoice_<entity>_<date>.csv alongside the PDFs. The CSV will include columns: line_id, description, unit_price, qty, tax_amount, entity_id, cost_center_code.
- Credit notes: we support issuing entity-specific credit memos that reference the original invoice number; they'll be generated as creditnote_<entity>_<orig_invoice>.pdf and included in the next month's billing package or delivered ad-hoc per your preference.
- Collections cadence: we can set Net 30 by default. If Mosaic needs a different term per entity please advise.

We'll prepare a sample package (PDFs + CSV) and a short reconciliation guide and send it to billing@mosaichealth.com by EOD tomorrow. If that works I'll mark this thread as ready and attach sample files.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Billing Ops | Redwood Inference
